Headquarters: Remote

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

The Director of Sales, Velocity is a key leadership role within the Sales division. You will build, develop and lead a global team of Account Executives who close high volume SMB deals. This is a coaching-first leadership role. Your team will be early in career, and your ability to grow them into confident, consistent performers is what drives results. You will shape the Storyblok Velocity sales motion, scale revenue across regions and own the plans, processes and people strategy behind it. You will also build the talent pipeline from which Storyblok’s next generation of sales leaders will emerge.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Lead, coach and scale a global team of Velocity Account Executives

• Build and run a structured coaching program covering call reviews, deal inspection, skills development and clear progression paths

• Design and refine the Velocity sales motion, including playbooks, qualification, pipeline coverage and sales cycle benchmarks for high volume SMB deals as well as graduating self-serve customers to enterprise and running signal based motion

• Own regional and global revenue targets for the Velocity segment, with accurate forecasting and clear accountability

• Define and track the activity, conversion and velocity metrics that drive performance, and act on them quickly

• Partner with Marketing, BDR, PLG, Partners, Sales Operations and Product to optimize lead flow, handoffs and the end-to-end customer journey

• Lead hiring, onboarding and ramp for new Account Executives so new hires reach productivity fast

• Build a high-performance, positive and inclusive team culture across time zones

• Create a clear promotion framework that moves top performers into Mid-Market and Enterprise roles

• Analyze sales data to spot trends, risks and opportunities, and turn them into action plans

• Continuously improve sales processes, tooling and automation to increase efficiency at scale

• Report on Velocity performance and insights to senior leadership on a regular cadence

• Stay close to market trends, competitor activity and SMB buyer behavior across regions

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing or a related field, or equivalent experience

• 8+ years of progressive sales experience, with at least 4 years leading sales teams, ideally in a high volume, transactional or SMB environment

• Proven track record of developing early-career sellers into top performers and building a coaching culture

• Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding revenue targets with a high velocity sales motion

• Experience leading distributed or global teams across multiple regions and time zones

• Experience scaling sales teams and operations in high-growth environments

• Strong command of pipeline management, forecasting and performance analytics

• Working knowledge of MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification methodology, adapted for short sales cycles

• Excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and hold a junior team to a high standard

• Proficiency with CRM software and sales analytics tools

• Experience selling SaaS or similar technology products is highly desirable

• A positive, can-do attitude and a drive to inspire your team to overcome challenges

• A proactive approach to identifying and launching initiatives that improve team success and business growth

• Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to use AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking

U.S. Base Salary Range: $173,800 - $225,000

At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. For some roles Storyblok also offers a competitive commission structure.

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

GENERAL TERMS

Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here.

All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain (storyblok.com).

Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor

If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/storyblok-velocity-sales-director-usa-europe

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. Strategic Account Executive – VIC & QLD (New Logo)

Location: Melbourne or Brisbane (Field-based/Hybrid)

Territory: Victoria & Queensland

Travel: Regular monthly interstate travel, plus deal-driven customer visits

About the Role

As a Strategic Account Executive (VIC & QLD), you will take ownership of an expansive, high-potential territory with a focus on hunting and securing net-new logo accounts.

This is a field-based, strategic sales role designed for a proactive builder who thrive on opening new enterprise doors, navigating multi-stakeholder enterprise deals, and establishing foundational partnerships across key commercial and public sector.

You won't be doing it alone. While the role demands an autonomous hunter’s mindset, you will be backed by a strong bench of dedicated technical architects, business value consultants, marketing, and a leadership team that brings deep, proven experience selling Ping solutions into net-new environments. We set our reps up to win with realistic, market-tested quotas and a transparent, highly rewarding compensation plan built to maximise your earning potential as you scale.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive New Business: Build and execute a territory strategy focused on acquiring strategic net-new enterprise logos across Victoria and Queensland.

• Lead Complex Sales Cycles: Direct multi-threaded enterprise sales engagements from pipeline generation through to commercial negotiation and closing.

• Articulate Business Value: Position our identity and security platforms to C-level executives (CIOs, CISOs, CDOs) and enterprise buying committees.

• Leverage Internal Ecosystems: Orchestrate pre-sales engineering, solution architects, professional services, and executive leadership to advance and de-risk critical deals.

• Co-Sell with Partners: Collaborate closely with global systems integrators, regional channel partners, and alliance ecosystems to uncover and co-deliver strategic opportunities.

• Accurate Pipeline Management: Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene and provide predictable, transparent forecasting to regional leadership.

• Customer-to-Product Loop: Act as the voice of the market, translating feedback from prospect interactions directly to our product, marketing, and engineering organizations.

What We Are Looking For

• Enterprise Hunter Pedigree: Extensive, proven track record carrying and exceeding enterprise quota, specifically driven by net-new logo acquisition.

• Complex Deal Mastery: Documented success closing six and seven-figure transactions involving long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

• Executive Presence: Strong network and confidence engaging C-level stakeholders, translating technical capabilities into tangible business outcomes and risk mitigation.

• Methodology-Driven Execution: Formal grounding in structured value-selling and enterprise account planning frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger).

• Partner Acumen: Experience working alongside global and regional system integrators to identify, validate, and win joint pursuits.

• Location & Travel Flexibility: Based in either Melbourne or Brisbane, with willingness to travel interstate on a regular monthly basis and as required to drive high-impact customer interactions.

What We Offer

• Uncapped Earning Potential: Highly competitive base salary, realistic quota design, and transparent commission structure.

• Experienced Leadership: Direct support from a local management team that has walked in your shoes and knows how to close new logo enterprise accounts in this market.

• Dedicated Deal Support: Comprehensive technical, marketing, and bid management resources to give you an unfair advantage on every pursuit.

• Flexible Work Culture: Autonomous, outcomes-focused environment balancing hybrid work with meaningful on-site customer and team engagement.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

• A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.

• Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.

• Regular company and team bonding events.

• Competitive benefits and perks.

• Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

• Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 

• Parental Leave

• Progressive Healthcare Options

• Retirement Programs

• Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 

• Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ping-identity-account-executive-new-logo-hunter

  • 2 years plus experience in similar role

  • Social medias and social selling best practices

Minimum qualifications: Currently enrolled in or graduated from a degree program within Product Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Internship or Teaching Assistant experience in product management, software development or a similar technical field. Experience leading entrepreneurial efforts or outreach within organizations while building cross-functional relationships. Experience preparing and delivering technical presentations to an audience through internships, coursework, or extracurriculars. Preferred qualifications: Experience with methodologies aimed to drive product development and delivery. Experience applying Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) concepts to build products or features through relevant internship, capstone projects, or other academic work. About the job At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day. In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development. One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users. Google aims to build products that organize the world's information and make it universally accessible to our users. As a Product Manager at Google, you could be working on new technologies, platforms, consumer facing products, and/or enterprise systems. The end goal will be to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, experience, and where you will have the most impact. Responsibilities Understand markets and user requirements in depth. Launch products and features, test their performance, and iterate quickly. Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and User Experience (UX) on technologies. Develop innovative solutions to problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. About the role

For most people, health insurance happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life. Thatch is changing that. We help companies give employees a healthcare budget instead of a one-size-fits-all plan, so people can choose the coverage and care that works for them while employers get predictable costs.

It's a simple idea, but making it real means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology. We're just getting started. We look for people who use good judgment, take ownership, and care deeply about building something that matters.

Design is central to what makes Thatch stand out. We're building a brand that sets a new standard for healthcare. We're a small, collaborative team with high standards for craft, bold creative thinking, and a shared ambition to make something complex feel remarkably simple.

We're looking for a Brand Designer to help shape Thatch's next chapter. We've built a product people love, and now we're ready to bring that same ambition to our visual identity. You'll develop creative concepts and bring them to life across web, campaigns, events, print, and more, helping define how people see and experience Thatch.

What you'll do

• Shape and evolve Thatch's visual identity, building a distinctive, cohesive brand across every touchpoint.

• Develop and execute creative concepts across our website, campaigns, digital content, events, print, and more.

• Own design projects end to end, from early exploration and creative direction through production and launch.

• Partner with Marketing, Product, and Design to translate business goals and complex ideas into compelling creative work.

• Present and advocate for your ideas, incorporating feedback while maintaining a high bar for craft and consistency.

• Collaborate with external creative partners when needed, bringing fresh ideas and approaches to how we tell our story.

What we are looking for

• 3–5 years of experience in brand, visual, or marketing design, ideally at a startup or high-growth company.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft across typography, layout, color, and visual storytelling.

• Experience translating a brand identity into cohesive, high-quality work across digital and physical touchpoints.

• Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

• Ability to move quickly, iterate thoughtfully, and deliver polished work.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain design decisions and collaborate across teams.

• Comfort with ambiguity, a sense of ownership, and the judgment to know when to challenge the brief.

Experience we’d be particularly excited about

• Motion design, animation, or video experience.

• Ability to build and ship web experiences using HTML/CSS, Framer, or similar tools.

• Experience using AI tools to explore ideas and improve creative workflows.

• Experience helping a growing company evolve its brand.

What to expect

We aim to keep our interview process thoughtful, rigorous, and efficient. Most candidates complete it within three weeks.

• A 30-minute conversation with a recruiter.

• A 30-minute conversation with the hiring manager.

• A portfolio review focused on your creative process, visual craft, and brand thinking.

• Functional interviews focused on creative collaboration, communication, and working style.

• A final conversation with a member of our executive team.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/thatch-brand-designer

Headquarters: Remote @ Colombia

About the role: 

The OfferUp Connect team builds the moments that turn a listing into a sale. Every chat between buyers and sellers, every offer notification, and every saved-search alert runs through services we own, from messaging and notifications to location, meetups, and the subscriptions sellers pay for. We run high-volume Java microservices and streaming pipelines, integrate with partners like Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple, and Google, and use experimentation to decide what ships.

We also take on high-visibility work beyond our domain. Connect built OfferUp's video infrastructure for listing videos and LLM-powered catalog enrichment on Amazon Bedrock, both company priorities that changed what buyers see every day. The roadmap is wide open for someone who wants to help shape it.

As a Software Development Engineer II, you'll own features from concept to rollout: designing and writing well-tested code, launching experiments, and measuring results with Product, Design, and Data partners. You'll raise the quality of the code around you and get the chance to join the next project like video or catalog enrichment.

Here’s more of what you will get to do:

• Design, build, and deploy backend services and event-driven pipelines for messaging, notifications, location, and subscriptions

• Improve the reliability, latency, and delivery rates of high-volume messaging and notification systems, including retries, rate limiting, and frequency capping

• Integrate with and operate third-party platforms such as Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple and Google push services, and app store billing

• Own features end-to-end: plan, design, develop, deploy, measure, and iterate

• Break down complex engineering problems into achievable tasks and deliver them within committed timeframes

• Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and iOS, Android, and web engineers) to design and implement new features

• Contribute to A/B tests and use experimentation results to decide what ships

• Actively participate in code reviews and enforce good patterns, testing, and edge-case handling

• Coach and mentor junior team members, new hires, and interns

• Create shared components, utilities, and services that improve team velocity across the stack

• Maintain and improve the runbooks, alerting, and monitoring for the features you ship

• Participate in a reasonable on-call rotation with the rest of the team

• Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini, and similar) to increase your daily development velocity and code quality

• Become a subject matter expert in one or more of the team's sub-domains: messaging, notifications and campaigns, location, or subscriptions and promotions

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

• 2+ years of professional software engineering experience

• Demonstrated ability to own the delivery of multiple features end-to-end (plan, design, develop, and deploy) with high efficiency, including breaking down engineering problems into achievable tasks

• Strong coding skills in Java, with a working understanding of microservices and distributed-systems fundamentals

• Good knowledge of data structures and object-oriented design

• Working knowledge of asynchronous, event-driven systems (queues, pub/sub, or streams), including retries and idempotent processing

• Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code or similar) in a real engineering workflow, and a point of view on when they help and when they don't

• A habit of following good coding patterns, writing appropriate tests, considering trade-offs, and seeking out edge cases

• Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in code reviews

• A bias toward shipping, learning from production, and iterating quickly

• An insatiable desire and ability to learn

• BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

Helpful, but not required:

• Fluency in another modern object-oriented programming language

• Experience with TypeScript and Node.js

• Experience with Agile development

• Experience building and integrating with REST APIs

• Experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, Lambda, and ElastiCache (Redis)

• Experience with notification and engagement platforms (Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, APNs, FCM) or in-app subscription billing (App Store, Google Play)

• Experience with stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink or Kafka Streams

• Experience with A/B testing platforms (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) and analytics warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake)

• Experience consuming or integrating LLM-based APIs (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI, OpenAI)

• Familiarity with Kubernetes, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines

About OfferUp:

OfferUp is dedicated to creating the simplest and most trusted way for people to buy, sell, and connect in their local communities. 998e28d1e15e8ba7.description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 

The Role

As a Manager, Customer Success, you will lead a team of approximately 7-8 Customer Success Managers responsible for a combined portfolio of Upmarket customers with annual contract values ranging from $100K to $500K and representing approximately $15M-$20M in ARR.

You will be responsible for driving customer retention, adoption, customer value realization, and operational excellence across your team's portfolio while developing and coaching a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers. This role requires a strong people leader who can balance business performance, talent development, forecasting discipline, and customer outcomes.

Success in this role requires the ability to develop top talent, create accountability, establish operational rigor, and partner cross-functionally to ensure customers realize measurable business value from their investment in 6sense.

You will work closely with Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to help customers achieve their goals while contributing to the continued growth and scale of the Customer Success organization.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 7-8 Customer Success Managers supporting Upmarket customers.

• Create a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Conduct regular coaching sessions, performance reviews, talent assessments, and career development conversations.

• Establish clear expectations and operating rhythms that drive consistent execution and customer outcomes.

• Recruit, onboard, and develop Customer Success talent while supporting succession planning across the organization.

• Inspire and motivate a team that consistently delivers exceptional customer experiences and business results.

Drive Customer Success Outcomes

• Lead a team responsible for customers with annual contract values between $100K and $500K and a combined portfolio of approximately $15M-$20M in ARR.

• Drive strong Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), customer adoption, customer satisfaction, and value realization across the portfolio.

• Coach Customer Success Managers on account strategy, executive stakeholder engagement, success planning, renewal strategy, risk mitigation, and value delivery, ensuring they understand and own the renewal process.

• Ensure Customer Success Managers proactively identify customer risks and execute strategies to improve retention outcomes.

• Partner with Sales leadership to align on customer health, growth opportunities, and strategic account planning.

• Drive a high level of customer engagement and executive alignment across key accounts.

Drive Operational Excellence

• Own portfolio forecasting processes, renewal inspections, customer health reviews, and risk management practices.

• Ensure consistent execution of success plans, Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), account reviews, and customer engagement standards.

• Use data and analytics to identify trends, improve performance, and drive informed decision-making.

• Drive adoption of Customer Success processes, tools, and best practices across the team.

• Champion initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, forecast accuracy, and customer outcomes.

Partner Across the Business

• Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Professional Services, Support, Marketing, and RevOps to deliver a world-class customer experience.

• Act as a voice of the customer and advocate for customer needs across the organization.

• Support strategic initiatives focused on customer retention, product adoption, operational scale, and customer value realization.

• Help shape the future of Customer Success programs, processes, and operating models as the business continues to grow.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of people leadership experience leading customer-facing teams within a SaaS organization.

• 8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Professional Services, Consulting, or other customer-facing roles.

• Proven track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.

• Experience leading teams responsible for customer retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.

• Strong understanding of SaaS business models and key metrics, including GRR, churn, forecasting, customer health, and product adoption.

• Experience coaching teams on executive engagement, account strategy, value realization, and risk management.

• Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.

• Demonstrated ability to drive operational rigor and accountability through data-driven management practices.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into action.

• Comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools and workflows to improve team productivity, customer insights, coaching effectiveness, and operational scale.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Ability to travel up to 25% for customer meetings, team events, and company programs.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience leading Customer Success teams supporting enterprise or upmarket SaaS customers.

• Experience managing teams responsible for portfolios between $15M and $20M in ARR.

• Experience within MarTech, AdTech, SalesTech, Revenue Technology, or related B2B SaaS industries.

• Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Clari, Gong, and other customer success technologies.

• Experience helping scale Customer Success organizations, teams, and operating models.

Why 6sense

At 6sense, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, influence the future of Customer Success, and directly impact customer retention and business outcomes across a diverse portfolio of Upmarket customers.

You'll work alongside some of the industry's most innovative leaders while helping customers transform how they identify, engage, and convert buyers. You'll have the autonomy to make an impact, the support of a world-class leadership team, and the opportunity to grow your career while developing the next generation of Customer Success talent.

If you're passionate about building great teams, creating exceptional customer outcomes, and helping scale a world-class Customer Success organization, we'd love to hear from you.

Base Salary Range: $113,400-150,100. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote
